_readme: Declared holes in the stroke data, read by scripts/validate/validate_stroke_integrity.py.
Every entry carries a reason. An entry that matches nothing (the hole was filled, the
mismatch was repaired, the orphan row was dropped) is itself a FAILURE: the exemption must
be deleted in the same commit that fixes the data, so this file can only shrink.
Seeded 2026-08-26 from the migration-audit findings G12 (coverage), G13 (counts), G14 (kana).
